main.description: Withdraw a write-notification registration made through registerNotify. On a space host, unsubscribes from the whole space; on a repo host with a `repo`, unsubscribes from that repo only. Idempotent: succeeds whether or not a matching registration existed. Registrations also lapse on their own at the expiry returned by registerNotify, so this is for explicit withdrawal rather than cleanup. Authenticated with a space credential.

repo.description: The DID of the specific repo to unsubscribe from (repo host). Omit to unsubscribe from the whole space (space host). Must match the registration being withdrawn.

service.description: Service identifier of the subscriber to remove, as passed to registerNotify.
